note: Per-round ledger of this target's review history. The commit/merge gate keys freshness on the sibling record (<key>.json) — a fresh review of the exact reviewed bytes — but --record now refuses to file a record unless this ledger's last round reviewed those same bytes, so a record can never be filed for content the ledger never saw. This file is the history the record itself cannot carry: what each round found, what was fixed, what was refuted by execution. Rounds are appended in order; a header key already present is never rewritten or dropped by a later append.

findings_fixed: Indirect names for a written file (all six; found and fixed independently while the round ran, confirmed as 6 false grants in real bash): a command that names a written file carries its text and passes it on, so cat f1 > f2 taints f2 and cat f | bash feeds bash; once any file is written, a later command that could run text is held if any word could expand to a name — a glob, a dollar, or a backtick. Escaped quote inside a heredoc-body substitution (antigravity, deepseek): to be confirmed in real bash and fixed by skipping backslash escapes in the quote scan.
findings_refuted_or_deferred: minimax: the dot-slash go.sh boundary claim — the character before go.sh in ./go.sh is a slash, not a dot, so the look-behind passes; the self-test row KARTA_SKIP_GATE=1 echo ... > go.sh && bash ./go.sh expects a deny and passes.
rounds.notes: All 6 responding reviewers returned verdicts; the tight word-limited prompt ended the output-cap truncation seen in round 5.
